name: Codex CLI

archive.note: Unzip beside ~/.agents/skills and ~/.codex/prompts as INSTALL.md describes.

agents.note: Codex has no subagent file format; the persona is emitted as an ordinary skill so it stays invocable.

hooks.note: Codex has no equivalent of Claude Code lifecycle hooks. Wire the same checks into CI or a git pre-commit hook.

mcp.note: Codex keeps MCP servers in ~/.codex/config.toml. The build emits a snippet to merge; apkit never rewrites that file for you.

notes: Codex resolves skills from .agents/skills (repo, then parents, then repo root), then ~/.agents/skills, then /etc/codex/skills.
Skills can be toggled per-skill via [[skills.config]] entries in ~/.codex/config.toml.
